name: Madison River (Lower)
gaugeName: Madison bl Ennis Lake nr McAllister
blurb: Bozeman's classic summer float below Ennis Lake — plus Bear Trap Canyon if you want real whitewater.

sections.notes: Bear Trap Canyon. Not a tube float. Scout Kitchen Sink. Permits/use limits can apply — check BLM/FWP.

putInAccess.note: River-side Wilderness Boat Launch above Bear Trap Canyon; checked against the BLM recreation description and satellite imagery.

takeOutAccess.accessType: Paved boat ramp and hand launch
takeOutAccess.sourceName: BLM Warm Springs Day Use Area
takeOutAccess.note: Boating access is documented by the managing agency. The unchanged agency coordinate identifies the facility/parking or bridge-access area, not a surveyed ramp edge. Kept as an approximate area marker; exact shore connections and the downstream bank are not verified.
takeOutAccess.directions: Enter the signed Warm Springs day-use area off Montana Highway 84, about 20 miles northeast of Ennis. Use marked parking spaces; do not park along the entrance road or highway. California Corner is a separate overflow parking and hand-launch area about half a mile downstream.

sections.notes: The beer-can hatch. Watch for shallow gravel bars in late summer.
sections.routeReview: General Madison River course only. Shore connections, present bridge passages and the navigable channel are not mapped. Retain the documented access-area markers and existing planning distance; inspect the actual landing and current conditions.

sections.notes: Quieter Lower Madison float. Use the designated Greycliff access; shoreline land is not automatically open for stopping.
